title: Attributing Kiosk Drawdowns to a Lapsed Micro Market Funding Lot
content:
Where substantial subsidy has been drawn at the kiosk of an Unattended Micro Market Program market, not all of it is set against the funding that has lapsed. What is set against the lapsed funding turns on whether any of the drawing falls outside the months a lot stays drawable.

## Conditions

**Only what was drawn before those months is set against the lapsed funding, the lots being drawn oldest first**, where at or above 5000 USD has been drawn against the agreement, and some of what was drawn falls outside the months a lot stays drawable.

**Half of everything drawn is set against the lapsed funding**, where at or above 5000 USD has been drawn against the agreement, and none of what was drawn falls outside those months.

**Where less than 5000 USD has been drawn against the agreement**, no such attribution is made.

## The boundary

The material drawn amount is 5000 USD drawn against the agreement in all: exactly 5000.00 USD is at or above it, and 4999.99 USD is below it. The months a lot stays drawable are those printed against the market format, counted from the day the funding cleared. Either figure set against the lapsed funding is taken to the nearest cent, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent.

*Hypothetical.* An agreement on which 14000.00 USD has been drawn in all, of which 9000.00 USD was drawn within the drawable months, sets 5000.00 USD against the lapsed funding. An agreement on which 14000.00 USD has been drawn in all, every penny of it within the drawable months, sets 7000.00 USD against the lapsed funding. An agreement on which 3200.00 USD has been drawn reaches neither condition.
